body:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Hunt <danielle.hunt@acme.com>, Jose Perez <j.perez@bluebay.ai>, Calvin Morris <calvin@summitretail.com>, Priya Singh <psingh@vectorcloud.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Group drop-in demo + technical office hours — choose a time

Hi all —

Thanks for your interest in a group demo and technical office hours for Redwood Inference. We’re running a short, hands-on drop-in session to cover:
- Quick platform tour (10 min)
- Model selection & cost/latency tradeoffs (10 min)
- Live Q&A + runtime deep-dive (30 min)

We want to make this useful across teams and timezones. Please pick the slot that works best for your group:
- Option A: Tue 27 Apr, 10:00–11:00 PT (13:00–14:00 ET)
- Option B: Wed 28 Apr, 17:00–18:00 PT (20:00–21:00 ET)

Quick logistics: we’ll send a single calendar invite for the final slot and post the agenda/short pre-reads here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=agenda-20270418
I’ve attached a one-page agenda and will include a calendar invite once we lock the time.

Attachments: 20270418-dropin-agenda.pdf (one-pager)

If you have specific topics you want covered (e.g., embeddings at scale, private deployment), reply with a single line and we’ll slot it into the Q&A.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0197

Hi Marcus — thanks for organizing. For BlueBay, Option B (Wed 28 Apr evening PT) works best for our engineering team — later in the day gives us time to join after stand-ups.

A quick ask: can you include a short segment on autoscaling behavior under burst traffic? That’s our primary concern right now.

—Jose

Folks —

Quick update from the ops side: our runtime engineer who runs the autoscaling walkthrough has a conflict on Wed the 28th. We can either:
- keep Option B and run a lighter Q&A (no deep autoscale demo), OR
- move the session to Thu 29 Apr, 09:00–10:00 PT so the engineer can join and we can include the live autoscaling demo.

If your teams are reliant on the autoscale segment (Jose mentioned it explicitly), we’d recommend Thu 29 Apr morning PT. Please let us know by EOD Wed and I’ll lock the calendar.

I’ve also attached a short env checklist for anyone planning to try the hands-on snippets during office hours.

Attachments: 20270418-dropin-agenda.pdf, demo-env-checklist.txt

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor

Subject: Confirmed: Group drop-in demo & office hours — Thu 29 Apr 09:00 PT

Thanks for the quick replies and for flagging the autoscale ask — we’ve moved the session to Thu 29 Apr, 09:00–10:00 PT to include the live autoscaling demo.

I’ve just sent a calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) to this thread — please accept. Agenda (final): https://drive.google.com/open?id=agenda-20270418
Topics: platform tour, model selection, autoscaling walkthrough, live Q&A.

If anyone needs an alternate time or would like a separate 1:1 deep-dive, drop me a note and we’ll set it up. Looking forward to it.

Best,
